case.amount_and_min_out_status: illustrative; opening-prefix historical fill not replayed

transaction.gas_price: do not set a separate legacy gasPrice
transaction.gas_limit_update: ceil(1.20 * G_success) after historical-prefix or representative fork simulation; initial limit usable only if G_success <= 833333
transaction.priority_status: historical matching-tip baseline, not guaranteed strongest

scheduler.inflight_policy: no fixed transaction-count cap; track outstanding transactions and fee exposure asynchronously
scheduler.replacement_note: background status check first; raise both fee caps on the original nonce; provider replacement rules must be checked; replacement abandons exact matching tip
scheduler.window_note: no routine wait for previous receipts; pause an affected wallet for funding shortage, nonce gaps, unknown transactions or reorg recovery; never skip a nonce gap

nonce.startup: read canonical latest nonce and reconcile the existing signed-transaction journal to initialize next_nonce; pending is supporting evidence only
nonce.allocate: single writer per wallet allocates n, n+1, n+2 locally; persist signed raw bytes, hash and fees before broadcast; do not wait for the previous receipt
nonce.reconciliation: background worker asynchronously processes preconfirmations, receipts, account nonce, gaps and fee exposure; routine reconciliation does not block the normal send path
nonce.acceptance: RPC hash means accepted, not consumed; timeout does not free nonce; rebroadcast the same signed bytes after background status reconciliation
nonce.receipt: both successful and reverted included transactions consume nonce; retain journal until canonical confirmation
nonce.replacement: same nonce, same buy intent, higher fee fields; rebroadcast exact bytes to both ordinary endpoints; do not count as a new nonce allocation
nonce.fee_exposure: sum the maximum fee exposure per unresolved nonce plus L1 and other fees; count competing same-nonce replacements once at the higher exposure
nonce.reorg: pause the affected wallet, roll back provisional consumption and reconcile canonical nonce, bought state, and journal before resuming
nonce.implementation_status: paper and configuration design only; no EOA scheduler runtime is implemented

rpc.read_primary: one dedicated Flashblocks-aware HTTPS/WSS provider; endpoint supplied by operator
rpc.submit_backup: one dedicated ordinary submission RPC; send identical raw bytes
rpc.public_policy: fallback diagnostics only; do not rotate public RPCs to evade limits
rpc.ordinary_request_capacity_requirement: up to 1000 total send calls/second across two submission paths, plus replacements and reads; respect each endpoint's actual quota
rpc.validity_policy: only explicitly supported validity endpoints; never broadcast the same conditional signature via ordinary RPC while its predicate is false
rpc.node_note: self-hosted or dedicated RPC is not the sequencer and does not reserve priority

contract.funding: pre-fund shared executor with 100 USDC; each keeper has ETH for its own pending fee exposure
contract.route: fixed preverified V3-compatible pool; no flash loan, no factory traversal and no router approval in buy()
contract.sqrt_price_limit_x96: 4295128740 for this token0-to-token1 direction; minOut remains mandatory
contract.compatibility: mock tested; actual pool implementation, proxy implementation and successful historical-prefix path must be verified separately
